landing.heroLead: Your land, on the map and in the register.
landing.whatBody: One public register for every plot in Mogadishu: surveyed on the map, checked by the land office, published for objections, then registered with a unique number you can rely on.

register.title: Register your land
register.body: Apply online or at the district office. A surveyor draws your plot and you get a Parcel Unique Number (PUN).

pay.title: Pay property tax
pay.body: See your bill and pay by EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab, bank or cash, with a receipt every time.

verify.title: Check before you buy
verify.body: Every registered plot is on public notice first, and every certificate carries a QR code anyone can verify.

owner.label: Property owners
owner.text: Your plot gets a boundary, a number and a record of its owners — so nobody can quietly sell what is yours.

buyer.label: Buyers
buyer.text: Before you pay, look the plot up, check who owns it and whether anyone has objected or a dispute is open.

bank.label: Banks
bank.text: A verified title with a known boundary is something you can lend against. Liens and transfers are recorded on the same register.

staff.label: District staff
staff.text: Applications, surveys, verification and registration in one workspace, with every decision recorded and checked by a second person.

landing.howBody: Seven steps, each recorded. You can follow your application at any time with its number.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Owners, documents and a pin on the map — online, at the office or with a field officer.

fee.title: Application fee
fee.body: Paid by mobile money or at the cashier, or waived by finance with a recorded reason.

survey.title: Survey
survey.body: A surveyor measures the plot on site and draws its boundary; overlaps with neighbours are caught here.

verify.title: Verification
verify.body: A land officer checks documents, identities and the survey.

notice.title: Public notice
notice.body: The plot is published so anyone with a claim can object before it is registered.

register.title: Registration
register.body: The registrar approves and the plot gets its PUN and account number.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.body: Collect your title certificate and property ID card, each with a QR check.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts, roles and district access.
users.newSubtitle: Create a staff account. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
users.emptyBody: Change the filters or create a new user.
users.rolesHelp: A user can have several roles. Roles needing access you don't have are disabled.
users.selfRolesLocked: You can't change your own roles or districts. Ask another administrator.
users.districtsHelp: District staff only see records in these districts.

users.readOnly: You can view this user but not edit them.

security.title: Security & status
security.subtitle: Actions here take effect immediately and are recorded in the audit log.
security.selfNote: Some actions are not available on your own account.
security.passwordBody: Set a new temporary password, or email a reset link.
security.setPasswordBody: The user is signed out everywhere and must change this password at next sign-in. It's copied to your clipboard.
security.mfaOn: 2FA is on. Reset it if the user lost their phone.
security.signoutBody: Sign the user out of every device now.
security.suspendBody: Blocks sign-in immediately. History is kept and the account can be reactivated.
security.reactivateBody: Allow this user to sign in again.
security.deleteBody: Soft delete keeps history. Hard delete is only possible without legal or financial records.
security.deleteConfirmBody: Choose how to delete this account, then confirm with your own password.
security.softDeleteBody: The account is marked deleted and blocked. Records and history stay.
security.hardDeleteBody: Permanently removes the account and frees the email. Super Admin only.
security.hardDeleteBlocked: Not available: only a Super Admin can hard delete, and only users without legal or financial records.
security.yourPasswordHint: Sensitive actions need your password again.
security.deletedBody: It can't sign in. History is kept in the audit log.

done.set_password: Password set and copied to your clipboard

billing.runsSubtitle: Yearly property tax and recurring fees, billed in batches with a preview and finance approval.
billing.newRunBody: Choose the year, the fee and the districts. A preview with counts, totals and exceptions follows before anything is billed.
billing.feeTypeHint: Property tax uses each parcel's assessment for the year; other fees use their fixed amount.
billing.noRunsBody: Start a run to bill a year's property tax for one or more districts.

steps.refreshBody: Recount parcels, totals and exceptions with today's data.
steps.submitBody: Finance reviews the preview and approves it. You can't change it after submitting; cancel and start again instead.
steps.approveBody: After approval the invoices can be generated. You can't approve a run you created.
steps.generateBody: One invoice is created per parcel and the owners are sent an SMS. Parcels already invoiced for this period are skipped, so this is safe to retry.
steps.cancelBody: No invoices are created. Give the reason; it is recorded.

billing.generated: {count, plural, =0 {No new invoices} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} created, {total} in total.

billing.cancelInvoiceBody: Only invoices with no payments can be cancelled. Use a credit note to correct an amount instead.

billing.newFeeInvoiceBody: Bill a one-off fee for this parcel, such as a certificate or reprint.
billing.amountHint: Leave empty to use the fee's amount ({amount}).
